gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-merriweather-sans: Bold, rounded letters stretch tall in Baloo Bhai 2, with wide-mouthed curves that grab the eye right away. Merriweather Sans backs it with sturdy, upright words.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-public-sans: Baloo Bhai 2 swells into big, rounded lowercase shapes. Public Sans stays hefty and trustworthy underneath, its broad counters doing the quiet work that the heading is too loud to do.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-ranade: Organic and professional, Ranade spreads its stroke ends far apart, with only a slight shift in weight along each line. Baloo Bhai 2 stays loud up top, so give the body a little more size to match.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-supreme: Commanding rounded letters stretch toward the top line in Baloo Bhai 2, which earns its keep when it runs big and short. Supreme then lays down a crisp, heavy-looking strip of text with its letters held open.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-manrope: Manrope reads bright and open, with a clean gap at every curve. Shrink Baloo Bhai 2 down, though, and its bold rounded lowercase loses the commanding presence that sets it apart from this constant-width sans-serif.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-montserrat: Montserrat glides along like wire, geometric and approachable. Baloo Bhai 2 earns its keep big and short, where its wide-mouthed rounds and bold, commanding shapes can stretch toward the top line.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-satoshi: Loud, round and tall, Baloo Bhai 2 pushes its wide-mouthed lowercase upward with real swagger. Satoshi, a plain sans with a soaring x-height, keeps every stroke at one width and never shows a hairline.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-switzer: Switzer reads like cut wire, tubular and tall in the waist, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Baloo Bhai 2 adds bold rounds above, but a long page of this sans would still feel approachable.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-work-sans: Work Sans sets its c tips well apart and keeps its joins as thick as its strokes, with a mean line set high. And Baloo Bhai 2 brings bold, wide-mouthed rounds, so the pair's strongest quality is how differently they handle weight.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-archivo: A tall central band of text gives Baloo Bhaijaan 2 its distinctive, commanding look, with open curves throughout. Archivo follows in an editorial, approachable plain sans whose curves open outward instead of curling in.
